test.create_query: CREATE DATABASE perf_catalog ENGINE = DataLakeCatalog('http://localhost:8181/v1', 'clickhouse', 'clickhouse') SETTINGS catalog_type = 'rest', warehouse = 's3://perf-catalog', storage_endpoint = 'http://localhost:11111/perf-catalog', catalog_credential = 'clickhouse:clickhouse', oauth_server_uri = 'http://localhost:8181/v1/oauth/tokens'
CREATE TABLE iceberg_rest_catalog_mark (http UInt64) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: SELECT throwIf(count() != 200) FROM system.tables WHERE database = 'perf_catalog'
INSERT INTO iceberg_rest_catalog_mark SELECT sum(value) FROM system.events WHERE event IN ('HTTPConnectionsCreated', 'HTTPConnectionsReused')
SELECT throwIf(sum(value) - (SELECT http FROM iceberg_rest_catalog_mark) < 200) FROM system.events WHERE event IN ('HTTPConnectionsCreated', 'HTTPConnectionsReused')
test.drop_query: DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS perf_catalog SYNC
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS iceberg_rest_catalog_mark SYNC
